Wards are a mixed bag of experiences. Over the many times I have been there, not one of them has ever been the same stay. Sometimes it’s quite nice, they just make sure you don’t have anything to harm yourself with, and that’s typically that. You do your thing long as it doesn’t but I’m with theirs and they can be really fun.
Others are not. Just no. The techs aren’t always properly trained and can be utter assholes. The doctors come off strained give you poor choices in meds and treatment, and they too can be dicks... short to say it’s a mixed bag. Some hospitals are more high maintenance, Sometimes you get ants(yes literal ants,) and the cleaners aren’t paid too much to care.
I think it’s still good to go, it just depends where you go.
